_comment: Delivery lifecycle failure alerts (operator 2026-10-25: 'Any failures I need to be emailed, notified, and texted.'; AGENTS.md §29 PROPOSED). Read by scripts/lib/delivery_failure_alerts.py only. Every failure below is an immediate P1 (never the digest): Telegram through the telegram_alert.send_telegram chokepoint (priority P1), email and SMS through the communications gateway (scripts/lib/comms/channel_adapters.send_via_gateway). Recipients and provider keys are read by the gateway adapters only (REPORT_EMAIL_TO; OPERATOR_SMS_EMAIL or TWILIO_SMS_FROM/TWILIO_SMS_TO), never here: this file names env keys so the lane can say NOT_CONFIGURED without reading a value. Changed only by reviewed PR.
